relatedItems.en: 1/48 Mega Size Model Mass Production Zaku

ja: • メガサイズモデルより、量産型ザクが追加装備とともに登場。■指揮官用ブレードアンテナ付き頭部パーツが付属。■バックパック、脚部バーニアといった量産型の通常推力装備を再現。■ザク・バズーカと専用手首など、豊富な武器パーツが付属。
成形品×21、水転写デカール×1、組立説明書、小冊子×1
en: • Mass-produced Zaku is now available with additional equipment from the mega-sized model. ■Head part with blade antenna for commander is included. ■Reproduces mass-produced normal thrust equipment such as backpacks and leg verniers. ■A variety of weapon parts are included, including a Zaku bazooka and a special wrist.
Molded product x 21, water transfer decal x 1, assembly manual, booklet x 1
